description: Team-scoped Linear ticket tools for engineering agents (find_issues/create_issue/list_agent_issues), with a duplicate-check before filing and an optional practice mode. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

team_id.label: Team Id
team_id.description: Linear team ID every query/mutation is scoped to -- a prompt cannot point the tools at another team.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding a Linear personal API key or OAuth2 access token (sent RAW, no 'Bearer ' prefix -- Linear's own convention).

practice_mode_env_var.label: Practice Mode Env Var
practice_mode_env_var.description: Env var NAME (not a value templated into this field) whose value, read fresh at call time, switches create_issue into practice mode: returns {'practice_mode': True, 'would_open': 'linear_ticket', ...} instead of actually filing a ticket. Same vocabulary/rationale as github_pr_tools' own practice_mode_env_var -- scope it to a Dagster+ branch deployment to practice there and act for real after merge.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: find_issues, create_issue, list_agent_issues.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key (python -m this module, with LINEAR_TICKET_TOOLS_* env vars set from this component's own settings, and the real API key passed through via live env passthrough). Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES (beyond the API key, which is always passed through) to copy into the spawned MCP server's env.

ledger_path.label: Ledger Path
ledger_path.description: Directory this tool writes one JSON-lines file per Dagster run_id into, recording every create_issue call as it happens -- filed, would_file (practice mode), or refused. Same shape/rationale as github_pr_tools' own ledger_path (the run_id comes from MCP's out-of-band request _meta, not a tool argument). Point an agent component's own outcome_ledger_path at this SAME directory to read it back. Unset: no ledger is written.

duplicate_check_lookback_days.label: Duplicate Check Lookback Days
duplicate_check_lookback_days.description: find_issues includes an issue closed within this many days, not just still-open ones. A person closing a bad finding (wontfix, already handled) is a signal not to re-file it -- without this, that signal is lost the moment the issue leaves Linear's active states, and an advisor agent re-files the same thing it was already told no about.
